description: Use this when the user asks who the Phorme coaches are, wants to pick a coach by personality, or names one (for example Miles, Atlas or Nutmeg). Each Phorme coach is a character who plans one kind of training: running, strength, mobility, HYROX, triathlon, athletic training, food, or the adaptive plan. It returns each coach with its animal, what it plans, the scene that shows it, its personality and the Phorme builds it coaches. It reads only and changes nothing.

coach.description: One coach's name, only when the user named one, for example "Miles".

name: meet_the_coaches

coaches.description: coach (its id), name, animal, plans (the training it plans), the_scene (what it does in one moment), personality, traits, builds (id and name; find_coaching_brain finds the right one) and colour.

limits.description: What this does not cover. Tell the user.

title: Meet the Phorme coaches
